categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
